annotation.emotional_arc: unconditional surrender and devotion to the beloved

stanzas.loss_note: The translation renders 'dil' (heart) as 'soul' in line 6, which shifts the emotional locus from the physical/emotional heart to a spiritual plane.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The beloved's memories are deeply integrated into the speaker's life and physical existence, constantly felt like a heartbeat.
acceptable_visual_variants: A close-up of a chest with a soft, warm golden glow pulsing in rhythm.
A silhouette of a person looking at the stars with a faint, glowing heartbeat line overlaid on their chest.
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Your memories reside/live inside my heartbeats.
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing literal memories or tiny figures living inside a beating heart, which looks like a medical anomaly or fantasy illustration rather than deep emotional devotion.

metaphor_mapping.tenor_concept: constant psychological presence in one's life

metaphor_spans.tenor: The deep emotional and spiritual influence of the beloved's words

metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a soft, glowing heart shape with elegant, abstract script or light patterns gently washing over or settling onto its surface.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation shifts the physical/emotional locus from 'dil' (heart) to 'soul' in the English rendering of 'mere dil par hai'.

The intimate, singular informal pronoun 'tu' (and its inflected forms 'tera', 'teri', 'tujhse') is translated as the standard English 'you/your', losing the specific register of deep intimacy or devotion conveyed by the Hindi pronoun.

annotation.theme: The complete dissolution of self-identity in the existence of the beloved.

original_poem:
मैं तेरा हूँ, मुझे तुझसे कुछ भी नहीं चाहिए।  
तेरे बिना, मेरी कोई पहचान नहीं है,  
मेरे हर ख्वाब में तेरा ही नाम है।  
तू है तो मैं हूँ, और तू नहीं है तो मैं नहीं।  
तेरी यादें मेरी धड़कनों में बसी हैं,  
तेरी बातों का असर मेरे दिल पर है।  
मैं तेरा हूँ, और तू मेरा है,  
यह वादा, यह इकरार, केवल तुमसे है।
translated_poem:
I am yours, I ask nothing from you.  
Without you, I have no identity,  
In every dream of mine, it is your name.  
If you exist, I exist; if you don't, I don't.  
Your memories are embedded in my heartbeats,  
Your words leave a mark on my soul.  
I am yours, and you are mine,  
This promise, this affirmation, is only with you.
